title: How to apply for a Nova Horizon credit card

sections.heading: Apply online
sections.text: You can apply for any Nova Horizon credit card with the online application form on our website. Rates, fees and limits for each card are in that card's product terms.

sections.heading: Help choosing a card
sections.text: The Nova Horizon assistant can explain and compare our cards and point you to the online application form. Applications are submitted through that form.

sections.heading: Application decisions
sections.text: The bank reviews each application and decides approval and the starting credit limit. Applying does not guarantee approval or a specific limit.

sections.heading: Due dates
sections.text: Each statement shows your payment due date and minimum payment. Pay at least the minimum by the due date to keep your account in good standing.

sections.heading: Ways to pay
sections.text: You can pay your card from a Nova Horizon checking or savings account with bill pay in online banking.

sections.heading: Late or returned payments
sections.text: A late or returned payment may add a fee and, on some cards, a penalty APR. The amounts for each card are in its product terms.

sections.heading: Requesting an increase
sections.text: You can ask the assistant for a higher credit limit at any time. The bank decides eligibility when you make the request.

sections.heading: How the bank decides
sections.text: The bank considers your account history and the card's maximum limit, listed in its product terms. A request can be approved in full, in part, or declined.

title: Moving from a secured card to an unsecured card

sections.heading: Graduation reviews
sections.text: Secured card accounts are reviewed for an upgrade to an unsecured card. On-time payments help. The review timeline is in the secured card's product terms.

sections.heading: Your security deposit
sections.text: For questions about your refundable security deposit, ask the assistant or send us a secure message in online banking.

title: Lost or stolen cards and suspected fraud

sections.heading: Lost or stolen card
sections.text: If your card is lost or stolen, tell the assistant right away. The card can be blocked so it cannot be used, and a replacement card can be issued.

sections.heading: Suspected fraud
sections.text: If you see a charge you do not recognize, report it to the assistant as soon as possible. We review the activity with you and can replace your card if it was compromised.

sections.heading: Fraud alerts
sections.text: We may contact you about unusual activity. We never ask for your full card number, PIN or password in a call or message we start.

sections.heading: Starting a dispute
sections.text: If a purchase is wrong, was not delivered or was not as described, contact the merchant first. If that does not fix it, contact us through the assistant or secure messaging.

sections.heading: During a dispute
sections.text: We review the charge with you and let you know the outcome when the review is complete.

sections.heading: Card fees
sections.text: Card fees can include an annual fee, foreign transaction fees, balance transfer and cash advance fees, and late or returned payment fees. Not every card has every fee.

sections.heading: Where to find fee amounts
sections.text: The exact fee amounts and rates for each card are listed in that card's product terms. Your statement shows any fees charged in the period.

sections.heading: Support channels
sections.text: You can reach support through the assistant or through secure messaging in online banking.

sections.heading: Talking to a specialist
sections.text: The assistant can connect you with a human support specialist when you need help it cannot provide.
